instrument_name: TN DLWD Wages, Fringe Benefits, Paychecks & Breaks (Wage Regulations Act, T.C.A. 50-2-103, 50-2-110, 50-2-202) - full text
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: Private employers with 5+ employees keep regular paydays; pay at least monthly. Monthly payers: wages earned before the 1st due by the 5th of next month. Two+ periods/month: earned before the 1st due by the 20th of the following month; earned before the 16th due by the 5th of the next month. Final pay: next regular payday or 21 days after separation, whichever is later; no exemption (50-2-103(g)). Accrued unused PTO/vacation payout only if policy or agreement requires (50-2-103(a)(3)). 30-min unpaid meal/rest break if scheduled 6 consecutive hours (50-2-103(h)). Offset deductions need a prior signed written agreement held by the employer (50-2-110(a)(2)). Pay reduction allowed if notified before the work is done. No pay-statement topic.

instrument_name: TN DLWD UI Tax Rates page (taxable wage base history and rate-table schedule)
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxable wage base 2026 USD 7,000 (7,000 since 2018; 8,000 2016-2017; 9,000 2014-2015); base varies with Trust Fund balance. Premium Rate Table 6 in effect 2026-01-01 and 2026-07-01 (table 6 continuously since 2015-07-01). Reserve-ratio method; employer reserve ratio effective for the UI tax year starting each July 1; Trust Fund balance on June 30 / Dec 31 picks the table for the next six months.

instrument_name: TN DLWD Premium Rate Chart for Nongovernmental Employers (tables 1-6)
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: Six tables keyed to Trust Fund level (table 6 = fund USD 850 million and over). Table 6 (in effect 2026): lowest rate 0.01% (reserve ratio 20.0 and over) up to 10.00% for the most negative reserve ratios; tables share the 5.00-10.00% range for negative reserve ratios. PDF text layout is column-shifted; read cell by cell before using a single row.

instrument_name: TN DLWD support article 202843724 How is my premium rate determined (Zendesk public API copy)
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: New employers pay the new-employer rate until 36 consecutive months chargeable ending Dec 31; since 2004-07-01 new-employer rates for NAICS sectors (manufacturing split 31/32/33) follow the sector's combined reserve experience; new-employer rate for all other industries 2.7%. Experience rate = reserve ratio (premiums paid less benefits charged as of Dec 31, divided by average 3-year payroll) read on the effective table.
verification_method: inspected directly (help-centre API JSON; HTML page is behind a bot check)

instrument_name: TN DLWD support articles: Filing and Amending Wage Reports (41492672876947); Filing Wage Reports Using Full ICESA (41492819469331); Employer FAQ (41544930827027)
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: Quarterly UI wage and premium report filed in Employer e-Services (TNPAWS closed; tax functions live 2025-05-27): manual entry, abbreviated ICESA or 58-character text file upload (processed immediately), or full ICESA (single employer or TPA/PEO bulk; processed overnight); files validated on upload and rejected on error. Amendments: increases post at once; decreases need reason + documentation and staff approval. Online registration gives account number and rate immediately; household employers must also register. New-hire reporting is not in this system: run by TN Department of Human Services. Employer e-Services access only from US/Canada.

instrument_name: TN DLWD support article 50850930363667 Who is required to file a WARN Notice in Tennessee
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: TN WARN (Tennessee Plant Closing and Reduction in Operations Act) applies to private for-profit and nonprofit employers with 50+ full-time employees or 50+ employees working together at least 2,000 hours/week. Not a payroll calculation item; notice obligation only.

instrument_name: TN DLWD Form LB-0489 Separation Notice (Rev. 08-2020) with instructions
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
article_or_section: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 0800-09-01-.02 (cited on the form)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer must hand or mail form LB-0489 to each separated employee within 24 hours of separation (Rule 0800-09-01-.02), stating reason (lack of work permanent/temporary with recall date, discharge, quit), severance pay / wages in lieu of notice amounts and period, vacation pay on temporary layoff. Not required for an employee employed less than a week or recalled within seven days. Page 1 carries the UI-availability notice (claims 844-224-5818, jobs4tn.gov). Form references the State Quarterly Wage Report LB-0851 and Premium Report LB-0456.

instrument_name: TN DLWD New Hire Reporting page
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers report newly hired or rehired employees within 20 days of hire; DLWD matches against UI claimant files; separate duty to verify work authorisation under the Tennessee Lawful Employment Act. Programme run by TN DHS (US-TNS5-005, US-TNS5-009).

instrument_name: TN DHS Child Support Program employer brochure (rev. 2026-03-11)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer duties: report new hires within 20 days (tnnewhire.com); enrol children in health coverage when ordered (within withholding limits); withhold per IWO; remit to the TN Child Support State Disbursement Unit (P.O. Box 305200, Nashville TN 37229) within 7 days of the date the employee is paid; call the employer line when an employee receives a lump sum (bonus, profit sharing); report termination to the child-support office on the IWO; e-IWO and ACH/EFT available. Employer line 800-446-0814.

instrument_name: Davidson County (Nashville) Circuit Court Clerk form Answer of Garnishee - wage garnishment calculation per T.C.A. 26-2-404(b) (disposable earnings as defined in 26-2-216)
figure_or_rule_carried: Ordinary debt: disposable earnings = gross pay less social security and federal income tax; withhold the lesser of 25% of disposable or disposable minus 30 x federal minimum hourly wage (x2 biweekly, x2.166667 semimonthly, x4.333334 monthly); then subtract USD 2.50/week per dependent child under 16 living in TN (5.00 biweekly, 5.42 semimonthly, 10.83 monthly). Alimony (ex-spouse remarried): same as ordinary. Child support / alimony (not remarried): 50% (supporting another spouse/child, arrears < 12 weeks), 55% (>12 weeks), 60% (not supporting another, < 12 weeks), 65% (>12 weeks), or the ordered amount if less. Statute text not read (Lexis); form is a court-issued statutory worksheet.

instrument_name: US DOL Wage and Hour Division - State Minimum Wage Laws (Tennessee entry)
authority: U.S. Department of Labor Wage and Hour Division
figure_or_rule_carried: Tennessee: no state minimum wage law; employers subject to the FLSA pay the federal minimum wage USD 7.25/hour. (Local preemption of local minimum wages, T.C.A. 7-51-1802, read only on tier-B/CTAS leads: not registered as a number.)

instrument_name: TN DLWD support article 203123940 Legal restrictions against firing/suspending/disciplining (employment-at-will exceptions)
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: Employment at will, with protected absences: military service (T.C.A. 8-33-101 to -109), voting (2-1-106), wage garnishment (26-2-101 to -410), workers' compensation claim (50-6-101 to -705), jury duty (22-4-108): employer must pay wages during jury service less what the court pays. Whistleblower law 50-1-304.

instrument_name: TN DLWD Unemployment Insurance Tax page (liability and registration)
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
article_or_section: Who is liable; PEO; Seasonal employers
figure_or_rule_carried: Every TN employer registers online; liable employers get an 8-digit account number. Liable: FUTA-liable with 1+ TN employee; USD 1,500 gross wages in a quarter or 1 employee in 20 weeks; successor; 501(c)(3) with 4+ employees in 20 weeks; all state/local government; domestic service cash wages USD 1,000+ in a quarter; agricultural 10+ employees in 20 weeks or USD 20,000 in a quarter. PEO: register as PEO and each client (UIT-P account), separate quarterly wage reports per client, client rate = PEO aggregate rate; client jointly liable unless PEO posts USD 100,000 bond. Seasonal employer designation via LB-3304 (Sept 1 - Oct 31).

instrument_name: TN DLWD support article 360001003928 What is the delinquent cycle (quarterly UI report due date)
authority: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
figure_or_rule_carried: Quarterly UI wage and premium report is due by the end of the month after the quarter (e.g. Q1 by April 30; i.e. Apr 30, Jul 31, Oct 31, Jan 31). Unfiled: delinquent notice about 3 weeks after due date; Notice of Pending Assessment by certified mail 30 days later; assessment 30 days after that.

instrument_name: TN Parental Leave Act (T.C.A. 4-21-408) and voting leave (T.C.A. 2-1-106) pay rules (lead only)
authority: Tennessee Human Rights Commission; TN Secretary of State (pages not obtained)
figure_or_rule_carried: LEAD ONLY: 4-21-408 up to 4 months unpaid leave (pregnancy, childbirth, adoption, nursing) for employees with 12 months' service at employers with 100+ full-time employees at the job site. 2-1-106: up to 3 hours off to vote, no pay reduction, request before noon the day before; not owed if shift starts 3+ hours after polls open or ends 3+ hours before close. THRC page HTTP 404 on 2026-11-02; sos.tn.gov voter page HTTP 403. US-TNS5-012 (A.3) confirms 2-1-106 protects voting absence but does not state the pay rule.
